reviews.t: Best thing to touch my face!!!!
reviews.x: If I could give 10 stars I would! Being an active duty Marine for going on 10 years shaving everyday is a requirement. I switched to using majestic aftershave splash because regardless of my safety razor and smooth shave my face is extremely sensitive and is always irritated. This aftershave splash is a saving grace for me every single day!!! The witch hazel doesn't cause any burning sensations regardless of if I have nicks or burns, it immedietly soothes and gives off a sent of pure manliness!!

reviews.t: Forest fresh air smell
reviews.x: Doesn't burn after I shave when I apply it. The smell is amazing, the bottle could have a better cap but oh well personal con by not bad at all. Smells like a wildly woodlandish smell

reviews.t: Love it!
reviews.x: This is a FABULOUS product. I decided to try it because I saw it on "Today's Deals" list, but I will definitely buy it again and again.

reviews.t: Fantastic!!!
reviews.x: This stuff smells amazing. I have incredibly sensitive skin and this does not irritate or dry my skin like most aftershaves.

reviews.t: Clean & Crisp Aftershave
reviews.x: Amazing product soft and gentle on the skin Refreshing and gives you the feeling of being rejuvenated. Great addition to use post shave or whenever u wanna feel clean. Will purchase again.

reviews.t: Great Stuff!
reviews.x: This aftershave has a perfect blend of essential oils to soothe the skin after shaving.  It has some of the best in there, and works exactly as I would have expected.  It does not have a overbearing smell at all, and works swimingly.  I would definitely recommend this aftershave.

reviews.t: Great product, got this for my fiance as a ...
reviews.x: Great product, got this for my fiance as a Valentine's gift along with the sterling silver viking blade and it goes hand in hand perfectly. The smell is not too strong or overpowering, perfect for a "clean" shave. Love that it's organic and contains witch hazel, aloe leaf, and tea tree, all things that relieve itchy, irritated skin / razor bumps. When he shaves at night and uses it, you can still smell it on his face the next morning and heals any minor imperfections overnight. Great buy

reviews.t: Not sure what this is, but it's not an aftershave
reviews.x: Very disappointing product. It purportedly contains witch hazel and tea tree, but neither ingredients are evident. You feel none of the astringent properties of witch hazel, nor any of the menthol that is in tea tree. It has literally no scent, and there is no sensation on the skin of any kind when applied after shaving. It would not surprise me if the actual ingredients were water and glycerin and nothing else.

reviews.t: No Pump!?!?!
reviews.x: I was disappointed to open this product to see no pump!?!?  Clearly in the picture there is a pump on this container.  I ordered this product for the pump.  Why show it with a pump if you aren't going to ship it with one?  A pump is a very desirable feature on a bathroom product.

reviews.t: Good aftershave
reviews.x: I really like this aftershave. It doesn't burn my face Ike alcohol based aftershave. The scent is very masculine and pleasant, but I would like it a little stronger. It's gone within minutes of application. The only other thing that could be improved would be a stopper in the opening of the bottle that slows the amount poured for each application. I always seem to pour too much.

reviews.t: After shave/shower that you aren't gonna smelll on everyone (yet)
reviews.x: This is really nice after shave (shower) the odor isn't going to knock you down, it stays in the background, hints of lemon/citrus/lime, its hard to say which, but its a nice clean smell that you won't get tired of.  Its got front and center in my med. cabinet and it pushed some (very expensive) one's to the rear.....Well done !!

reviews.t: Its calming and soothing. There is basically no smell ...
reviews.x: Its calming and soothing. There is basically no smell, which may be a plus for some. It has stopped several nicks of mine from bleeding (I use an old fashioned safety razor ) .

reviews.t: I really like but would be better if it were a spray
reviews.x: I really like but would be better if it were a spray, pour bottle I lose a little sometime when pouring out.

reviews.t: Don't like fake perfumey after shave but want to tone and tighten your pores- this one is for you
reviews.x: Very light and almost no scent for those guys who don't like fake smells, this is perfect.  My husband said it was almost like putting water on his face.  Yet it has some great tightening and toning ingredients for the skin.  Aloe vera, witch hazel, Willow bark extract, and tea tree oil, perfect balm to close up the pores after shaving and give the skin what it needs for health and acne prevention. It makes his face feel smoother and isn't drying for the skin.  Great purchase!

reviews.t: ... get all the one star reviews saying that it's like water. Maybe a bad batch
reviews.x: I don't get all the one star reviews saying that it's like water. Maybe a bad batch, or a bootlegged  shipment...? Mine smells great and feels really good after a shave. It doesn't sting but you do know you put on aftershave  (NOT cologne).

reviews.t: Simple, soothing, and easy on razor burn.
reviews.x: I was looking for an unscented aftershave - I didn't want anything to clash with the colognes I wear intermittently, and I didn't want to spend lots of money on matching aftershaves for those colognes. This is pretty pleasant. The aloe and tea tree oil is soothing, and the scent is light & quickly dissipates (mostly witch hazel, with a tea tree oil finish.)  If I had to complain about anything, it's that the mouth of the bottle in which it ships is a bit big in terms of dispensing the aftershave

reviews.t: Good stuff if allergic to dye or fragrance
reviews.x: I have a problem with acne at 48 years of age. Only some aftershaves will work.  In grown hair is my enemy.  This aftershave works well. It dies not come with a pump as pictured.  Hard to splash from bottle without spilling, but I bought a empty soap pump bottle.  Great customer service!

reviews.t: It's like water. The five star reviews ALL paid for ...
reviews.x: I can't give it zero stars and I can't return it now that we've opened it. Purchased as part of a birthday gift for my husband based on 5 reviews and scent description. It has ZERO scent unless you put the product directly into your nostrils then it is faint and fleeting.  It's like water. The five star reviews ALL paid for with "free product". Frustrating.

reviews.t: I'm almost certain its just regular water
reviews.x: Just like what everyone else saying, this is an expensive bottle of distilled water. There is no scent at all. When you put it on, there's no aaaah feeling. Hopefully amazon invistigate the product and the seller

reviews.t: Very disappointed! You might as well splash water on your ...
reviews.x: Very disappointed! You might as well splash water on your face!! Don't buy this product! No fragrance no cooling affect nothing at all...Wow!

reviews.t: My husband really liked it. Great aftershave does not sting or burn ...
reviews.x: My husband really liked it.  Great aftershave does not sting or burn ehen used. It has a light refreshing  smell and can be used with any cologne  you have.  The only downside is I wish it had a por spout on the bottle because when I poured in my hand it kind of dribbled everywhere.

reviews.t: Great aftershave, been using for about aND can already ...
reviews.x: Great aftershave, been using for about aND can already see a difference. Love the mild scent as opposed to the heavy fragrance found with other aftershave splashes. Only wish the bottle opening was smaller to help prevent spills.

reviews.t: Very pleased
reviews.x: leaves face refreshed and moisturized. Clean scent with no chemical odors. Very pleased

reviews.t: Fantastic product, difficult to apply without spilling.
reviews.x: I just bought this aftershave after reading the reviews on Amazon. I recently purchased a safety razor so that I didn't have to spend so much on disposable heads of fancy razors, but after shaving felt like my legs were burning, so thought that I would try aftershave. I was a bit surprised that the bottle was open, it didn't have a smaller hole on the top so that less came out. Needless to say, I got the stuff all over the place when I tried to pour some in my hands. I quickly applied to aftersh

reviews.t: Not Bad
reviews.x: Been using this for a few weeks.  I actually like it better than when I first tried it.  It has lasted longer than I expected, at first you don't feel like it's doing anything, in a week you can tell your skin is improved. My bottle did lack any dispensing option, so it just pours out the bottle. I might buy it again, haven't decided. It's a good product, just don't expect immediate results.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the scent as pleasant, light, and not overpowering.
Reviewers frequently say it is gentle and soothing on sensitive skin, without the burn of alcohol-based aftershaves.
Some reviewers note the scent is very weak or essentially absent, which a few see as a plus but others find disappointing.
A few reviewers complain about the bottle's dispensing, citing a missing pump or preferring a spray over a pour bottle.
Several reviewers mention repurchasing or recommending the product.
